metadata.description: Folio, PulseWise and MarkRoom: three tools for Claude Code, by Zoke.

plugins.name: folio
plugins.description: Folio — a quiet archive that keeps long chats light.

plugins.name: pulsewise
plugins.description: PulseWise — a live bar for everything Claude is doing. A progress bar under the task list: one beat per point sized by time, a track for each background job, and the project's other chats, filled by real work.

plugins.name: markroom
plugins.description: MarkRoom — your review room: mark it, note it, and Claude changes it.
